label: Top sellers this quarter
description: Sellers ranked by total order value in the current quarter.
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_company_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_company_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20

label: Products with low review scores
description: Products averaging under 3 stars, minimum 10 reviews.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 AND AVG(r.review_score) < 3 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 50
